# Datamunge

![Datamunge logo](assets/datamunge.png)

\\color(Warning! This repo is under construction. The API is not stable and may change
without notice. Use at your own risk.)

Datamunge is a library for those who go rummaging around in data. It provides
datastructures and algorithms for manipulating and analyzing data and provides
bindings for a large collection of languages. It's a one-stop shop for data
munging, providing everything you need.
